items.text: 10 hours in everyone mysteriously starts getting on my tiny little ship in the main space port k-leg then they all proceed to die of asphyxia while the game is indicating totally fine oxygen and nitrogen.  I guess the CO2 was high, but beats the piss out of me why, it was the main space port after all.  This is a complete bug ridden mess after like 3 years+ of development.  Its a shame too cause they have some good ideas for a space game, kind of slow but potentially entertaining.  But don't waste your time its broken software.
items.text_zh: 玩了10个小时后，在主太空港，所有人都会神秘地登上我那艘小小的飞船，然后他们全都因窒息而死，而游戏却显示氧气和氮气完全正常。我猜是二氧化碳太高了，但我完全搞不懂为什么，毕竟那可是主太空港啊。经过大概3年多的开发，这完全是一团充满bug的烂摊子。这也挺可惜的，因为他们对太空游戏有些不错的想法，节奏有点慢但可能挺有意思。但别浪费时间了，这就是个坏掉的软件。

observations.description: 氧气和氮气显示正常但角色窒息死亡
observations.evidence: die of asphyxia while the game is indicating totally fine oxygen and nitrogen
